note: Core reader journeys a production package needs for its frozen source digest (docs/RELEASE_CONTRACT.md). Run them on the deployed preview of that package, never on a dev server. A results file lists one row per journey x required device: {journey, device, status: pass|fail, browser, evidence}. Parity and per-route device rows in routes.json stay progress, not release gates.

devices.label: Desktop Chrome or Edge, current stable, 1280+ wide
Android phone, Chromium browser (K60 Ultra Edge over CDP)
iPhone or iPad Safari on the deployed preview
Oldest supported engine check (Nox WebView); records the floor behaviour

journeys.title: 冷启动首页
journeys.pass: The Portal renders with idol scope and almanac; no permanent loading curtain, no console error, no failed same-origin request.

journeys.title: 首页 → 偶像 → 卡片详情
steps: From the Portal open an idol
Open one of the idol's cards
journeys.pass: Each page shows its title, images and data rows; the voice plays; the browser address is the public path.

journeys.title: 深链接与刷新
steps: Share-link preview shows the page title
journeys.pass: Both open the same page after refresh; canonical points at the release origin; no fallback to the Portal.

journeys.title: 返回 / 前进
steps: Portal → song catalog → song detail → back → back → forward
journeys.pass: Every step restores the previous page, scroll position and filters without a blank frame.

journeys.title: 剧情阅读器
steps: Open the reader for one episode
journeys.pass: Text, speaker names and translation render; the table of contents navigates within the episode.

journeys.title: 剧情播放器（语音）
steps: Start the player from a story
journeys.pass: Background, characters and voice play in sync; leaving returns to the story page; no resource-failure notice.

journeys.title: 歌曲试听
journeys.pass: Audio plays and switches without the layout growing; the play state is visible.

journeys.title: 谱面
journeys.pass: Notes move in sync with the audio; changing difficulty keeps playing; the track texture is present.

journeys.title: 2D 舞台
steps: From LIVE open 2D舞台 for one song
journeys.pass: Performers, lights and audio play; exit returns to the previous page.

journeys.title: 摄影工坊
steps: Pick a background and an idol
journeys.pass: The composition renders and the saved image matches the canvas.

journeys.title: 搜索与筛选
steps: Search an idol name on the Portal
Filter the card catalog by rarity and attribute
journeys.pass: Results update for both; the filter state survives a refresh through the address.
